name: How long does it take to install a new lever door handle?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install a new lever door handle?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a new lever door handle on an existing door typically takes 30 minutes to an hour per handle. This estimate includes removing the old hardware, preparing the door, installing the new latch mechanism, and then mounting the interior and exterior levers. The total time can vary based on the existing door's condition, the complexity of the new hardware, and whether any adjustments to the door frame or boreholes are needed. Professional installation ensures proper alignment and function, preventing issues like sticking or rattling.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation usually takes 30 minutes to an hour per handle, depending on the existing door's condition and hardware complexity.
